desc: 双结成环开场、织面与结背微距、四格片栏与空参数表收口
leaf: 男士商务斜纹色织领带
name: 绛红双结成环商务领带款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用完整成环剪影拿下首图位
一秒给出核心主张，用两条同结镜像承接首屏标题位
shots.textZone: top band for one headline slot, lower left for two short label slots

shots.intent: 把松垮歪斜与挺括成结并置，放大挑选焦虑
用织物表面与交织纹理证明用料与做工，承接痛点给出机制
让买家把自己代入商务场合，完成自我投射
shots.textZone: upper left dark area holds one short label slot

shots.intent: 展示背面缝合与挂环结构，解释为什么结型能站住
shots.textZone: right third holds one short label slot

shots.intent: 四格并置领结、中段、剑尖与全长，一次看全结构
shots.textZone: one label slot centred under each of the four panels

shots.intent: 让买家在同结构不同配色间做出选择
shots.textZone: one empty square index cell under each unit, no wording rendered

shots.intent: 用留白参数表消除规格疑虑，数值全部交给生成时填写
shots.textZone: five label chips with blank value cells on the right two thirds

shots.intent: 用留空索引与空印框承载信任点，避免任何伪造资质
shots.textZone: top band for one headline, four empty index cells and one empty stamp frame along the rail

shots.intent: 以留空按钮位收口，把行动点交回真实促销信息
shots.textZone: one empty button pill below the unit plus one short line slot above it

style.backgroundSystem: a warm chalk page #FAF6F1 carrying recessed greige card panels #EAE5DF joined by hairline dividers, alternating with one deep chestnut-graphite band #241C1A as the only dark field; never a single full-bleed colour across three consecutive screens
style.iconSystem: empty thin-line square index cells with one small triangular blade marker, one hairline circular chevron marker, one empty stamp frame and one unfilled indicator bar, outlines only in #241C1A or a single crimson #B32B3F at 1.5px; no filled pictograms, no hexagons, no diamonds
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from camera left near 4800K with a broad bounce fill on the shadow side, low-to-moderate contrast, one thin contact shadow under every blade, no cool cast, no specular blow-out
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm editorial menswear-accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm chalk paper #FAF6F1, greige card stock #EAE5DF, deep chestnut-graphite field #241C1A and one crimson accent #B32B3F; warm soft key from camera left near 4800K with broad bounce fill and one thin contact shadow under every blade; page-and-card layout carrying recessed grey cards with hairline dividers, alternating with one single dark band; one modern geometric sans-serif; empty thin-line square index cells with a small triangular blade marker, one hairline circular chevron and one empty stamp frame; stable knot and blade geometry hex-pinned to the reference with product scale locked between screens; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented specifications.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #FAF6F1, #EAE5DF, #241C1A and #B32B3F
no mixed fonts, no serif, script or retro lettering
no random backgrounds and no extra full-bleed colour fields
no inconsistent lighting direction and no cool cast
no mismatched icon styles and no new badge shapes
no invented specifications, percentages or certification marks
style.presentationRules: knot geometry, loop opening, blade width and tip stay identical to the reference in every screen; the tie always reads as one continuous woven blade with no invented pattern and no re-drawn stripe; any person is replaced by a head-cropped generic torso or by the tie alone; macro limited to the weave face and the reverse seam
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm chalk paper stock #FAF6F1, matte greige card stock #EAE5DF and one low graphite plinth #241C1A on the dark screens; no wood, no marble, no metal spheres, no fabric stage
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; one headline slot per screen plus at most three short labels, all rendered from generation-time placeholders, never from the source wording
